scope.included: Scythe 2016 base/core multiplayer for 2–5 players; complete exact frozen candidate material rules and important omissions.
scope.method: Read the full new candidate and compare throughout against the complete authoritative rulebook already read in this continuing source-only review. Re-read PDF pages 13, 14, 18 for new Mill totals. Source-only production, mat/recruit, six-tile and scoring diagrams were visually inspected in this review. No questions, keys, readers, grades, coverage or other reports read; no candidate or previous audit changed.

checked_claims.topic: Mill totals and current Produce allowance
checked_claims.claims_and_assessment: The new totals are valid arithmetic derivations: ordinary two selected territories plus controlled Mill territory gives up to three; upgraded three plus Mill gives up to four. Page 14 expressly describes upgrading Produce from two to three ignoring Mill, and p. 18 expressly makes Mill an extra bonus territory. Existing controlled-Mill qualification, optional production, per-worker output, Mill-as-worker output and no-output Factory terrain remain intact. Totals are territory allowances rather than resource-token counts and do not authorize duplicate production.

checked_claims.topic: Whole candidate and material omission review
checked_claims.claims_and_assessment: Read the complete new frozen summary, not only the changed Mill clause, against the complete source already read during this source-only review; no important core multiplayer omission found in setup, payment, permissions, unit/component destinations, factions, combat, encounters, Factory, ending or scoring.

Faction quantities one character, four mechs, eight workers, four structures and recruits, six cubes and stars; five mats and six tiles; shuffled decks, players+1 Factory cards with unused unseen, random structure tile, eleven encounters, random mats and board seating, correct starting tracks/cards/coins and two objectives; all piece locations, empty one-time spaces and lowest-mat start correct.

Public card count, secret contents/objectives, coin totals need not be revealed, combat commitment may be concealed; clockwise no rounds, distinct section except Rusviet, optional top then bottom once, either/both/neither, full exposed red cost before optional green benefit, top gains fund bottom, dead turns and appropriate bottom-action overlap.

Bases not territories; normal move/build/deploy prohibition with setup/retreat/Wayfare exceptions, inactive expansion placeholders; unit or unoccupied own structure control, enemy worker controls building territory/resources, defender temporary control; owner retains building effects except uncontrolled Mill. Only food/wood/metal/oil resources, workers excluded, resources stay on board, any controlled territory pays remote costs to supply, unlimited tokens/stacking.

Two different sequential units one step or one coin before upgrades; all carry resources, mechs only carry workers, carried workers may move themselves; rivers/lakes blocked by default, shoreline lake adjacency, printed tunnel adjacency, personal Mine even enemy controlled with normal entry restrictions; enemy structure alone enterable, worker hostile-entry restrictions; Speed adds plastic-unit step and intermediate loading.

Enemy workers/plastic stop character or mech for turn, encounter stops character for turn; undefended workers immediately home leaving resources, one popularity each down to zero, no combat. Finish movement then all attacker-ordered combats then encounter before subsequent bottom; lost contested encounter leaves token.

One coin for two power or one card, combat deck reshuffle/exhaustion; one coin for any two resources or one popularity, resource placement at controlled worker territory, not if all workers at home; correct Monument/Armory bonuses.

Full current cost before production; two distinct controlled territories before upgrade; one token per worker, terrain metal/mountain oil/tundra food/farm wood/forest worker/village and none/lake or Factory, tokens stay at producing location. New workers left to right after payment, may decline, future cost exposures only, permanent on board. Mill extra territory and worker output coexist with actual workers and work without actual worker.

Oil/metal/wood/food correspond to Upgrade/Deploy/Build/Enlist; use exposed mat quantities and varying costs/coins, optional coin benefit, completed paid actions continue coins/recruits, announce bottom action. Upfront Upgrade effect description does not change pay-before-cube sequence; cube any green to empty bracketed red, never solid black border.

Normal placement controlled worker territory, no lake/home base, mech ability all mechs and character not workers; one structure total per territory, Factory allowed, structures permanent, no opponent use; Armory power on Trade, Monument popularity on Bolster, controlled Mill, Mine personal tunnel including Factory movement even enemy controlled.

Any recruit to any empty one-time space, permanent, two power/coins/popularity/cards; ongoing original section, one power Upgrade, coin Deploy, popularity Build, card Enlist; own and immediate neighbors matching bottom, active-left-right priority, opponent once in two-player, top/Factory/encounter exclusions and immediate-end cutoff.

Rusviet repeat incl Factory; Crimea once per turn one card as one resource independent of value; Nordic workers swim rivers not lakes; Polania two different options from one encounter card any order, first benefit may pay second; Saxony unlimited available combat/objective stars and keeps second objective.
Rusviet farms/villages, Crimea farms/tundra, Nordic and Saxony forests/mountains, Polania villages/mountains; unlocked character/mech-only scope, all five can unlock Speed.

checked_claims.topic: Saxony and Rusviet other mech abilities
checked_claims.claims_and_assessment: Underpass controlled mountains/tunnels/Mine; Disarm opponent minus two power on tunnel/Mine battle once per combat. Township controlled villages/Factory; Peoples Army one extra total card with worker and required plastic unit, example two mechs/three workers gives three cards.

checked_claims.topic: Nordic and Crimea other mech abilities
checked_claims.claims_and_assessment: Seaworthy lake movement and optional adjacent-lake retreat incl carried workers; Artillery one own power to lose two enemy power once per combat. Wayfare own/inactive bases incl expansion not active enemies; Scout one random enemy combat card once per combat.

Submerge lake entry/exit and any lake to another; Camaraderie after winning aggressive combat only, not undefended worker displacement; no workers/resources left when carrier leaves lake, workers require mech to move off, no lake build/deploy, lake combat possible and Polania lacks Nordic retreat exception.

Zero power/popularity initiation permitted; attacker ability first, secret simultaneous dial zero to min(7,current), optional one card per plastic plus Rusviet bonus, cards allowed at zero dial. Simultaneous reveal, attacker ties, BOTH players deduct selected dial and discard ALL played cards face-up, cards do not deduct track power. Separate numbered reveal/payment steps agree with source.

Winner controls resources and mandatory eligible combat star, usual two cap versus Saxony and may still fight later; loser all plastic/workers retreat leaving resources, Nordic exception; attacker loses popularity for retreating workers incl lake-carried workers, defender none, Polania exception; loser one card for positive revealed power by dial/cards; unresolved later attacks undone at sixth star.

Character-only after all move/combat, token remains if battle lost; show card/art, read thematic capitals, choose required affordable option except Polania up to two, full cost and optional benefit; all units/resources/structures at encounter territory, no normal costs/mat/recruit extras, card face-down under deck.

Each characters first finish there must choose one permanent card, no exchanges; fifth action section optional top then bottom subject repeat rule/Rusviet; no analogous mat coins/structures/recruits, bottom one unit two steps or plastic with Speed three, ordinary stops/Mine. Factory no production and three territories total.

Own turn before/after top or bottom reveal with all requirements then; may defer, normal one objective star with both cards bottom-deck, Saxony keeps other; unenforceable deals, only coins tangible and tournament restriction, no negotiation cancelling initiated combat.

checked_claims.topic: Stars, sixth-star timing and recruit priority
checked_claims.claims_and_assessment: Six upgrades, four mechs/buildings/recruits, eight workers, objective, combat twice, eighteen popularity, sixteen power; once per usual category except combat and Saxony, permanent/unblocked. Sixth star immediately ends, no equalizing turns; finish bottom primary/coins/own ongoing bonus before ending star, active-left-right neighbor sequence and cutoff, undo pending mixed attacks.

Held coins plus stars, territories, resource pairs, selected structure bonus; popularity 0–6 pays 3/2/1, 7–12 4/3/2, 13–18 5/4/3. Factory THREE TOTAL, all other controlled territories/lakes one, home bases none, sum counts before popularity multiplier; controlled resource pairs pooled rounded down, workers/cards excluded. Tie order workers+mechs+structures, power, popularity, resources, territories, stars.

Adjacent printed tunnels 1/2–3/4–5/6 pay 2/4/6/9; lakes/encounters 1/2–3/4–5/6–7 pay 2/4/6/9; structures on printed tunnels 1/2/3–4 pay 2/4/6; longest straight row and combined farm/tundra structures 1/2/3/4 pay 2/4/6/9; Mine excluded, removed encounters count, features unique across structures, rivers do not break adjacency/row, enemy control irrelevant to bonus, zero gives zero.

limitations: Scope is the supplied base/core rulebook; no external FAQ, later edition or component-card corpus audited. Mat-dependent costs/benefits are correctly read from exposed physical mat boxes. Full global inventory, combat-card frequencies, strategy/narrative and optional teaching demonstrations are acceptable summary omissions.
conclusion: PASS for the exact candidate-repair-05.md hash recorded. New Mill totals are correct derivations of current Produce allowance plus one bonus territory and retain control/output restrictions. Full candidate check found no material contradiction or important core multiplayer omission.
